Source: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} Guide, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference-st.JournalEntry.yEPxZHRgMGIQ2JJQ]{Derangements}

You believe you can no longer feed on mortals or vampires other than those in your pack, and become ill when vitae from other sources passes into your system.

Trigger/Effect: Your Vinculum ratings are two higher than the result of the night's Vaulderie. This derangement makes diablerie almost impossible; it's up to the Storyteller whether you may spend Willpower Traits to attempt diablerie or feed from another source.
